Recorded claim:
The shadow-DOM `<select-all>` contract derives checked/mixed state and counts from managed inputs; it toggles enabled inputs only, while disabled selected children remain included in displayed counts/partial state. `ElementInternals.states` exposes `checked` and `indeterminate`; Account Hub consumes `:state(...)`. [Task 1]
